text_block_list.text:
On New Year's Day, Chrono Genesis invited me
to visit the shrine where Tracen Academy students traditionally go for Hatsumode.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-As my goal for this year...
I have pledged to achieve back-to-back Grand Prix victories...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A-And also... rather than just running... I-I want to hype things up even more than in usual years...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A-And if possible... I would love for as many people as possible to participate in the fan vote...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is a race made by the fans and Umamusume together.
I want so many people... to know that fun and joy...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I want you to experience...
the same thrill that moved me so deeply...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: However, in order to do that—

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen was so hyped!
The first back-to-back Grand Prix victories by a Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, with Almond Eye and all,
it really is the era of strong Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Is SchÃ¶n Lilie in 1st place
from the fan vote? Or through another qualification?

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I didn't vote, so
I guess I wasn't really paying much attention.
choice_data_list: Surprisingly, some fans haven't voted yet.
Surprisingly, there are fans who haven't voted yet, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ever since online voting became available,
the number of votes has increased quite a bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If possible... I want this vote to be something that
lets us share deep emotions with the Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: As a fan... I want them to enjoy the Grand Prix just as much as I used to get excited for it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because... Japan is the only place where
fan voting decides who gets to run.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
S-Some say the flourishing state of Japanese Umamusume racing...
is largely thanks to the power of the fans...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: In Australia, they even created a race with fan-voted entry slots modeled after the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the fan-voted entry slots
come with various operational challenges,
and the future outlook seems uncertain, but..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Japanese Umamusume racing... has long been supported and sustained by its fans...
choice_data_list: So that's why you're a symbol of Japanese racing history.
So that's why you're a symbol of Japanese racing history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That is another reason why, even among the
classic path... I chose the Grand Prix.
I see, a choice true to Chrono Genesis, who deeply values racing history.

To encourage votes for the Grand Prix...
what kind of appeal should we present?
choice_data_list: Let's play up the festive feel of the Grand Prix!
Why not tell them how feasible the Dream Race would be?
I wonder if we could spread it by word of mouth

text_block_list.text:
Whether it's a race or a festival,
it's always far more enjoyable to participate than to merely watch.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's right.
The Grand Prix holds a lot of participatory events,
including the fan voting...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: For the Arima Kinen, they even set up event booths all over town...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Casual fans too...
An event makes it much easier for everyone to join in...!"
"Casting your own vote makes a dream showdown come to life. There's really nothing more enticing than that, is there?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed... Perhaps its true charm
hasn't been conveyed well enough...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Those who have an Umamusume they truly care about...
are the very ones who should cast their votes, after all...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Appealing to people's 'fandom culture' side...
is definitely worth considering...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It seems official channels are already utilizing social media
for promotion, but... if we were to take it even further—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Do you mean... making waves that make people want to talk about them...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Loves-chan seems like she'd know
a lot about this sort of thing. I'll go ask her...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...
I will take your feedback to heart...!

"Knowing more about Umamusume allows you to enjoy the races on a deeper level.
If only there were a good opportunity for that—"
choice_data_list: In my case... I think it was Chrono's column.
In my case... I think it was Chrono's column.

text_block_list.text: For instance, learning about dreams passed down through bloodlines or rivalries between competitors has changed the way I enjoy races.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
M-My...!?
I-I don't have that kind of influence...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But... it's true, whether you can get
hype for a race or not... might depend
on how much you know about it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll think... about it...
Optimistically...!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's make it the best Grand Prix ever!
Yeah. Let's make this the best Grand Prix ever!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...! First, I'll take the Osaka Hai, and use it as a stepping stone to the Grand Prix...!
